#### What it does

Overpath is building a platform that enhances sales execution by analyzing live deal behavior and providing actionable insights. Unlike traditional sales tools that focus on post-mortem analysis, Overpath's AI model identifies execution gaps in real-time, enabling sales teams to adjust their strategies while deals are still active.

#### Traction

Overpath targets a global sales execution market exceeding $30 billion, focusing on revenue teams that struggle with inconsistent execution. The platform is designed for enterprise sales teams, leveraging a domain-specific AI model trained on real behaviors and methodologies of high-performing teams.
